# VertexV

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Surfaces](Blitz3D-Surfaces)

</div>


```blitzbasic
VertexV:Float32 surface:Int32, index:Int32, coord_set:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `surface` | In | Int32 | required | Surface handle. |
| `index` | In | Int32 | required | Index of the vertex, from 0. |
| `coord_set` | In | Int32 | `0` | Set of coordinates, 0 or 1. Defaults to 0. |

**Returns:** The vertical texture coordinate of the vertex.

## Description

_Not documented yet._
